# Release Notes Template

Copy this template when drafting a new release, then replace the placeholders.

---

## What's New

<!-- List new features, prompts, agents, or major additions. -->

- **\`file-or-feature-name\`** — One-line description of what it does and why it matters.

## Improvements

<!-- Model bumps, dependency updates, performance tweaks, or internal refactors. -->

- **Updated agent model assignments** — List each changed agent and its old → new model.
  - \`agent-name\`: \`old-model\` → \`new-model\`
- **Dependency pinning / bumps** — What changed and why (e.g., pinned from \`latest\` to \`^x.y.z\`).
- **Tooling bumps** — Runtime or package manager versions (e.g., bun \`1.3.12\` → \`1.3.13\`).

## Bug Fixes

<!-- Fixes for regressions or broken behavior. Omit if none. -->

- Description of the fix and the issue it resolves.

## Documentation

<!-- README updates, new guides, wiki additions, or inline doc changes. Omit if none. -->

- Description of what was documented or clarified.

## Other Changes

<!-- Anything that doesn't fit the categories above. Omit if none. -->

- Description of the change.
